schema.description:
A recurrence rule describes a repeating pattern of times. Recurrences rules in SavvyCal are modeled
after the conventions of [iCalendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ICalendar) recurrence rules (RRULE),
but are a subset of the full specification.

byday.description: The days of the week on which the recurrence occurs.

count.description: Number of occurrences at which to end the recurrence.

interval.description: How often the recurrence rule repeats.

until.description: Date at which to end the recurrence (in ISO-8601 format).

schema.title: RecurrenceRule
